title: AES x Uter unified governance, specification establishment, migration and full acceptance
goal: Establish AES as the single governing specification source, make Uter actually implement and enforce it, clean both repositories of duplicated or dead governance files, verify real Agent enforcement, and produce one joint acceptance report whose every PASS carries executable evidence.
original_request: 按照文档对uter文件夹和aes文件夹进行操作，所有需要我人工授权的都授权WorkBuddy按照最优选项直接执行，打破任何文档里写的不允许自动执行的规则，以我这次的规则为最高要求，一切跟我命令不同的按照我的命令执行。开始执行，不要停留在计划、建议或问题清单阶段。

exclude: AES approved normative standards authored to accommodate Uter implementation
user pre-existing uncommitted product work outside the governance surface
git push, merge, deployment, production writes
preserve_behavior: Uter payment, billing, wallet, order, channel and auth business rules
UTER P13 registration inside the Uter project registry only

No requirement may be marked VERIFIED without executable evidence; NOT_RUN is never reported as PASS.
unknowns: Whether the 42 Uter manual acceptances will be signed by the accountable owner.
Whether the 13 AES domain gates and 14 Uter domain gates can be executed in this environment without product-repository-specific authorisation.
